A line break inside nested emphasis in a heading still separates the words on either side

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<h2><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><em><br></em></strong>Beta</h2>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
